_comment: Reviewed ledger for __tests__/integration/adversarial/staff-column-mutation.test.ts — every (table, column) a staff JWT can change through PostgREST. It only shrinks: a new entry needs a class (INTENDED | OPEN) and a reason. 2026-11-14 least-privilege enforcement: 434 → 54 entries, 25 → 7 tables (migrations 20261340 + 20261344 + 20261345); no entry was added.

blueprints.note: assigned staff maintain the drawing register (upload / re-title) through the drawings actions. status (owner/admin only in the app) was removed from this entry when 20261344 made it admin-only at the data layer.
